glosses: (auxiliary verb, + παθητική μετοχή του ρήματος) χρησιμοποιείται να σχηματίσει την παθητική φωνή (passive voice)

examples.text: The earth is illuminated by the sun.

examples.text: I am to meet him tomorrow.

examples.text: It was to turn out bad.

examples.text: He was never to see his homeland again.
